_: The photo manifest. One row per photo the site renders: slug (the name the code asks for), file (the original in --src), ladoLargo (the long edge in px when it is not the default), alt text in both locales, and origen (bank, author, id, licence and the date and row it was chosen under). The originals live OUTSIDE the repo (~/Desktop/osppy-fotos by default) and .gitignore blocks *.jpg under public/photos. Run: node scripts/optimize-photos.mjs [--src <dir>]. No credits file: the Unsplash and Pexels licenses ask for attribution and do not require it; the author slug and the photo id stay in `file` and in `origen`, which is where traceability belongs. v6 (2026-09-08, HQA-D137): the site is largely photographs, all of them licensed bank photos of real people in real work settings, each approved by the operator one by one on the prototype (gate 3). NO model-generated image is in this manifest and none may enter (foundation §9). FASE 4 pruning (2026-09-08): the manifest lists only what the v6 renders. Fourteen rows left with their .webp, thirteen inherited from the v5 areas (facturacion, rh, nomina, marketing, comercio-exterior, operaciones, logistica, calidad, sistemas, servicio, legal, direccion, implementacion) and `hero`, the Gemini-generated mountaineer of the v5, which is the reason this file no longer says that a generated image may be kept for any purpose. No photograph that stands for an industry carries a visible company logo or foreign-language branding (HQA-D163). Calidad (2026-09-08, HQA-D168): el tope de la tubería pasó a 3200 px de lado largo y la calidad WebP a 82, porque el sitio muestra la mayoría de las fotos a sangre y 1600 dejaba media resolución en una pantalla de densidad doble; las catorce filas que traían ladoLargo 2400 lo perdieron, porque ahora las frenaría, y el campo sigue siendo el mecanismo para una excepción. Dos originales no llegan a 3200 y withoutEnlargement los deja en su tamaño nativo: hablemos (2400, que se muestra a 568 puntos y le sobra) y comercio-contenedores (3008, suficiente para 1440 a densidad doble). El tercero que se quedaba corto era contabilidad, y por eso se reemplazó.
